page.title: Choose capabilities
page.purpose: Let an operator pick the capabilities this install runs, and make the full consequence of each choice visible before they move on.

priorities.statement: An operator finds the capability they want without scrolling a hundred-entry catalog.
Selecting one scenario never hides what it drags in; the cascade is named on the same screen.
The implied resource set is visible before the operator leaves the step.
System capabilities read as deliberately locked, not as a broken control.

states.description: Catalog is being derived from manifests.
Catalog rendered; system-required entries locked on.
A search term narrows the catalog to matching scenarios.
The search term matches nothing; a one-click clear is offered.
A selected scenario has pulled in dependencies, and each is named.
The manifest catalog cannot be resolved on this tier; the step names which catalog is missing.

elements.description: Narrows the catalog by name and description.
elements.name: Search scenarios

elements.description: Narrows by selection state: all, selected, or available.
Marks a system-required scenario as not toggleable.
Names the scenarios a selection pulls in, and the ones it tries.
The resource set the current selection implies.
Names the manifest catalog that could not be resolved and the next action.

claims.statement: An operator can narrow a hundred-entry catalog by name or description without scrolling it.
Selection state can be filtered to all, core, or enabled.
When a selection pulls in other scenarios, each pulled-in scenario is named on this step.
The implied resource set is visible without scrolling before the operator continues.
A system-required scenario shows a locked indicator rather than an unexplained disabled control.
A search matching nothing renders dedicated guidance with a way back, not an empty page.
A tier that cannot supply the catalog renders a named, actionable message rather than a generic failure.
Every scenario entry, its keep-running toggle, and the search field are operable by keyboard alone.
The step reads search, then catalog, then the consequence of the current selection.
